title: Bifrost App Registry
description: The list of apps built on Bifrost Foundation, rendered as the 'Apps built on Bifrost' page and served verbatim at /apps.json for machine readers such as Foundation's in-product app list.

$schema.description: Relative or absolute path to this schema, for editor tooling.

appSource.description: Microsoft AppSource listing URL, or null when the app is not yet published there under this name.

docs.description: The app's documentation section on this site, or null if none exists yet.

repository.description: Public source repository URL, or null for a private repository.

support.description: Support contact: a URL or a mailto: link, or null.

logo.description: Repo-relative path to a 250x250 PNG logo.

appId.description: The app.json id GUID. Must be unique across the registry.

name.description: The app's display name, matching app.json name (without brand names retired from the family).

summary.description: One factual sentence. No marketing language.

summary_is.description: Optional Icelandic translation of summary, used on the is-IS registry page. Falls back to summary when omitted.

foundationMinVersion.description: Minimum Bifrost Foundation version this app requires, e.g. '28.0.0.0'.
